tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind the cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, forms.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table headers and secondary areas inside a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and headings on ground or surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, KPI labels and chart axes (6.3:1 contrast on surface).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers and chart grid lines.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button, links, completed analysis steps and the baseline line.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Link hover and text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the analysis result and of the evidence checks.

tokens.name: brand-on-dark
tokens.usage: Accents and primary button on ink backgrounds (AI bar, recommended action).

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Background of the active sidebar item (the sidebar itself uses ink).

tokens.name: sidebar-text
tokens.usage: Text of inactive navigation items on ink.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Normal status: badge text and dot.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Normal status: badge background.

tokens.name: status-alert
tokens.usage: Alert status and medium severity: text and dot.

tokens.name: status-alert-bg
tokens.usage: Alert status and medium severity: background.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical status, high severity and Real anomaly type. Only for states, never decorative.

tokens.name: status-critical-bg
tokens.usage: Background of critical badges and of the anomalous window in charts.

tokens.name: type-data-quality
tokens.usage: Data quality type: badge text.

tokens.name: type-data-quality-bg
tokens.usage: Data quality type: badge background.

tokens.name: type-explainable
tokens.usage: Explainable type: badge text.

tokens.name: type-explainable-bg
tokens.usage: Explainable type: badge background.

tokens.name: type-false-positive
tokens.usage: False positive type and low severity: text.

tokens.name: type-false-positive-bg
tokens.usage: False positive type and low severity: background.

tokens.name: chart-band
tokens.usage: Expected range band (baseline ± 3 MAD) in series charts.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Bars in the normal range; those above the threshold switch to brand or status-critical.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: A single family (Archivo, Google Fonts). Numbers always with tabular-nums.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: El consumo de M-109 pasó de 43,7 a 92,8 kWh por hora.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Consumo del último día frente a su baseline.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, table headers, axes (12px in charts).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Minimum spacing inside a block of text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped pills and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value; compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in 3–4 column grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of small cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections and card padding (22–26px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of the page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Side padding of the main content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Navigation items, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, meter tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and tables.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges 24px tall (half the height).
